Application Data.NAME: ABC Hardware & Home Improvement Store
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Hardware & Home Improvement Store specializes in providing a wide range of high-quality hardware, home improvement products, and related supplies. We offer a diverse selection of tools, paints, plumbing, electrical, garden supplies, and building materials to meet the needs of both DIY enthusiasts and professional contractors. Our store features a customer-friendly layout, allowing for convenient shopping and access to knowledgeable staff for assistance. We maintain strict inventory management practices and have implemented robust safety protocols to minimize risks and enhance customer satisfaction. We do not provide on-site installation or repair services, focusing solely on retail sales to mitigate liability exposure. Our inventory is valued at approximately $400,000, and we have a centrally monitored alarm system in place to ensure security against theft and vandalism.
